name: BreakevenStop
longCondition: el_gt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_ge(ctx.MaxPositionProfit(), activationProfit) && el_le(close[0], ctx.EntryPrice() - breakevenBuffer)
shortCondition: el_lt(ctx.MarketPosition(), 0) && el_ge(ctx.MaxPositionProfit(), activationProfit) && el_ge(close[0], ctx.EntryPrice() + breakevenBuffer)
